text:
I go against my interests in confessing it,
but I, my beloved,
agree with you that an ode is good only
when written on the back of a banknote.
Some fool, hearing this,
will surely cross himself and say,
“A woman of the nineteenth century,
materialistic and prosaic...” Nonsense!
Words spread by four poets
who wrap themselves in a lyre in winter!
Dogs barking at the moon!
You and I both know that in this life,
very few can write poetry with genius,
while anyone can make it with gold.

translation.title: Rhyme XXVI: I Go Against My Interests in Confessing It
